title: Whether white people can feel the blues; television
summary: She says some white people feel the blues but few would take what she took, then talks about her TV viewing.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Well, I'm very interested in what you think. Do you think that white people could feel the blues and feel the way you sing the blues as much as you feel it?

I imagine they do, I imagine some of them do. But mostly white people ain't going to take the mess that I took. Ain't no white people going to take all the mess that I took, because a white woman ain't going to take it. She won't even take it from her mother. I know -- this Victoria, this Vicki.
